subject: Acme vendor onramp — orientation + milestones and PO flow
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme vendor onramp — orientation + milestones and PO flow

Hi Jessica,

Great to meet you on the call last week — excited to get Acme set up on Redwood. I wanted to get a short orientation on the vendor onboarding steps and align on a compact mutual action plan (MAP) so we can hit your pilot date.

Suggested outcomes for the call:
- Confirm primary contacts for operations, security, and finance
- Walk through our vendor checklist and PO process (what we need from Acme)
- Agree on milestones: forms returned, PO issued, first test traffic
- Flag any compliance evidence you need (SOC2, data handling)

Proposed times this week (all PT):
- Tue 10/13 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 10/14 09:30–10:00 or 15:00–15:30

I attached a one-page checklist and our PO process summary to make the call efficient. Can you confirm which slots work and who from your side should join?

Thanks — I can tailor the MAP during the call and follow up with a timeline.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Redwood-PO-Process-Summary.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Acme vendor onramp — orientation + milestones and PO flow

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — confirmed that Tue 10/13 14:00 PT works for our side. I'll have myself (Vendor Manager) and Alex Chen from Finance on the call. Procurement (procurement@acme.com) is cc'd and will loop in legal if they see anything requiring redlines.

A few quick asks before we meet:
1) Do you have a blank MAP template we can review so we can pre-fill internal owners?
2) For PO timing: does Redwood accept purchase orders + net30, or do you prefer a signed SOW + invoice? We want clarity so Finance knows what to expect.

If you can drop a MAP template and a short list of required vendor forms, we can come prepared.

—Jessica
Jessica Ortega

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme vendor onramp — orientation + milestones and PO flow

Hi Jessica — perfect, thanks for confirming.

Answers / next steps:
- We do have a MAP template. Attaching a filled example and a blank copy so you can drop in owners ahead of the call.
- Redwood accepts POs + net30 for standard platform usage. For enterprise contracts where SOW or special terms are required we typically do a signed contract + PO. For your pilot, PO + net30 should be fine — Marcus (cc'd) is our Finance lead and can confirm any special billing routing.

On the call I'll run the checklist quickly (10 min), Marcus will cover PO/billing expectations (5–10 min), and Priyom will review the vendor form/process and where to upload completed docs (5 min). Then we can capture owners and deadlines in the MAP.

Attachments: ACME-MAP-template.xlsx (blank + example) — please pre-fill owners if you can.

Agenda for Tue 14:00 PT (30m):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) Vendor checklist walkthrough (10m)
3) PO/billing and invoicing path (5m)
4) Upload locations, forms, and security evidence (5m)
5) Agree on MAP owners & next milestones (5m)

Link to a shared drive folder is below so you can drop completed forms before/after the call.

See you then.

Best,
Kim
[Attachment: ACME-MAP-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
